program.name: Bend Me Over
program.subject: Flexible & bendy
program.blurb: Hamstrings and hips so you can fold over her and stay there: hinges for strength, forward folds held long.
program.about: For folding at the hips over her, from behind, and keeping the angle without your hamstrings pulling you out. One day strengthens the hinge, Romanian deadlifts, good mornings and back extensions, then stretches the hamstrings; the other is a long forward-fold flow, pyramid, wide-leg fold and half splits, held until they let go. Level II holds longer, Level III adds reps.
